input.command:
cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; cat > parking.py <<'EOF'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_HOUR * started_hours
EOF
P=/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python; $P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py; git commit -qm "Add the parking fee" -m "" --trailer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'
# boundary tests
cat >> tests/test_parking.py <<'EOF'


def test_thirty_minutes_is_still_free():
    assert fee(30) == 0


def test_zero_minutes_is_free():
    assert fee(0) == 0


def test_just_over_free_period_costs_one_hour():
    assert fee(31) == 2


def test_exactly_one_hour_costs_2():
    assert fee(60) == 2


def test_one_minute_into_second_hour_costs_4():
    assert fee(61) == 4
EOF
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git add tests; git commit -qm "Test the fee at the free and hourly boundaries" --trailer 'Mutant-step: task 1 input shape' --trailer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'

m(){ git diff -- parking.py > $W/task-1-mutant-$1.patch; test -s $W/task-1-mutant-$1.patch && echo ok$1; git checkout -- parking.py; }
